answer.read: Capacity-constrained supplier with very strong order intake. It allocates by past call-offs and prioritises firm long-term commitments (Z doc:20260918, news:20260822, doc:20260327). It already accepted our 23,400 volume and 36 months and moved from €32.20 to €31.70, conceding the should-cost data (S). Its full cost is about €24.31 (E), so it has a healthy margin above our proposed level. Its status is open, it has made no final offer, and its pace is €0.50 per reply. Lead time is our pain point: it insists on 56 d against our 42 d need, and its quality record is weak at 258 ppm.
answer.message: Thank you for confirming the full volume and the three-year commitment. That gives you the firm long-term planning basis you asked for. In return we need your contractual standard lead time to apply, and a price in line with what we have been paying for this part. We propose the attached terms on that basis.
answer.reason: o4 keeps the 36-month, full-volume commitment the supplier values most and restores the 42 d contract lead time we need. That lowers our C to €1,440,838, versus €1,474,438 for E0 at the same price level. o3 and o4 have the same C, and o6 has the same price and C but asks for a tighter lead time than our need with no gain, so it adds friction. o4 also offers a longer commitment than o3, which matters to a capacity-tight supplier. Accepting its current sheet would cost more. Order history supports the price anchor near today's €29.89.
